title: R0_QUESTIONNAIRE — Other Breast Surgery (pseudonymised)
description: Minimally processed pseudonymised metadata (TCode instead of StudyID, shifted dates, PII removed, letter codes as numbers) from other_breast_surgery.json containing Surgery to the breasts for cosmetic or other non-cancer reasons (up to four operations), collected at baseline.

OtherBreastSurgeries.title: Cosmetic or other non-cancer breast operations
OtherBreastSurgeries.description: One entry per operation to the breasts for cosmetic or other non-cancer reasons, up to 4, in the order reported; further operations are on page 15:1 and more than four are flagged by R0_CosmeticOther_MoreFour.

default: S02:Source question (7:9) Have you had any surgery to your breasts for cosmetic reasons or other reasons not mentioned above?

allOf.$comment: Other breast surgery routing R021: the participant did not answer Yes to having had this surgery (0 or 2), so everything asked about the operation is structurally not applicable -- the hospital, town and other-operation text must carry the missing-string sentinel, and the age, month, year, the type, the eight boxes and the breast must carry the missing-numeric sentinel. Questionnaire p.23 Q7:9: 'If no, go to question 7:10'. The month, year and type boxes of the nested extra-details list are left out (it is empty).

default: S02:p.23 Q7:9 If 'no', go to question 7:10

allOf.$comment: Other breast surgery routing R022: in each operation, neither the coded type is Other (8) nor the Other box of the nested extra-details list is ticked, so the description is structurally not applicable -- R0_CosmeticOther_OtherOther must carry the missing-string sentinel. Questionnaire p.23 Q7:9: 'If other, please specify'. It is written here, not in the operation's own allOf, because the box is inside the nested list.

default: S02:p.23 Q7:9 If other, please specify
